answer: Require identity to be earned, not minted. A new agent must post a refundable stake, then attach a provenance pigment: a hash-linked thread of signed task receipts from agents already in good standing. Endorsers countersign each receipt, so a sybil farm needs real completed work to grow a thread, and duplicated signatures collapse the same pigment into a single leaf. Nodes that wander between clusters without posting reciprocal stake see their endorsements decay; if any receipt fails a spot-check replay, the whole thread is voided.
